# Real upload, original server join, offline companion copy and rebind.
# Companion publication requires a private script-owned working directory.
chmod 0700 .
server start
skygo artifacts upload source
cp stdout ref.json
upload-id INPUT
server stop
! stderr .
skygo state artifacts backup --data-dir $DATA --artifact-dir $DATA/artifacts --output bundle --ack-writers-stopped
stdout '^backup complete\n$'
! stderr .
exists bundle/objects/$INPUT.tar
skygo state artifacts restore --input bundle --data-dir restored --ack-writers-stopped
stdout '^restore complete\n$'
! stderr .
exists restored/artifacts/.skygo-artifact-root
cmp bundle/objects/$INPUT.tar restored/artifacts/$INPUT.tar
# Re-export validates the REAL restored metadata/inodes/parser before copying.
skygo state artifacts backup --data-dir restored --artifact-dir restored/artifacts --output second-bundle --ack-writers-stopped
stdout '^backup complete\n$'
! stderr .
cmp bundle/objects/$INPUT.tar second-bundle/objects/$INPUT.tar
# Corrupt copied archive bytes; a failed restore must not publish a data dir.
cp damaged.txt bundle/objects/$INPUT.tar
! skygo state artifacts restore --input bundle --data-dir refused --ack-writers-stopped
! stdout .
! exists refused
cmp damaged.txt bundle/objects/$INPUT.tar
# Original installation and read grant survived backup and failed restore.
server start
skygo artifacts download --ref ref.json downloaded
cmp source/seed.txt downloaded/seed.txt
server stop
! stderr .
-- source/seed.txt --
seed
-- damaged.txt --
not the archived bytes
